items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: there was a show, Phyllis Newman had her one woman show and she wanted the theatre.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

at mid-town in Manhattan. So a theater had opened in mid-town on the sight of the old Latin Quarter which years ago was the Cotton Club, the site of the old Cotton Club. And so we moved into the, they call it the 22 Steps Theatre. So we moved in there and we had a short engagement there because, I don't know what happened, what happened was when you move into a theatre part of the arrangement was that if you don't gross a certain amount of money in a week.
